truncate_row_item: truncate all cells in a single row item to a maximum byte size while preserving specified columns
truncate_row_items_cells: truncate cells across multiple row items in reverse order until total size fits within byte limit

review_truncate_rows: review the truncate_rows module functions for row truncation logic and byte size enforcement
